description: Figure for the fungal ortholog test: bimodal distribution of N-terminal region length across 250 C1-THF synthase sequences from 188 fungal species, charge of the extra segment, and extension vs core sequence conservation

import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, itertools

def usearch(q,maxrec=1500,fields="accession,id,organism_name,sequence,ft_transit,length"):
    out=[]; r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"fields":fields,"size":500,"format":"json"},timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
    while True:
        out.extend(r.json().get("results",[]))
        nxt=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nxt or len(out)>=maxrec: break
        r=requests.get(nxt,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
    return out
recs=usearch('(family:"formate--tetrahydrofolate ligase family") AND (taxonomy_id:4751) AND (length:[850 TO 1100])')
ANCHOR=re.compile(r"[ILVM][ILVM]Q[VIL]G[A-Z]RPDS")
rows=[]
for rc in recs:
    s=rc["sequence"]["value"]; m=ANCHOR.search(s[:220])
    if not m: continue
    e=s[:m.start()]; R=e.count("R");K=e.count("K");D=e.count("D");E=e.count("E")
    rows.append(dict(acc=rc["primaryAccession"],seq=s,ext_len=len(e),ext_net=R+K-D-E,ext_acidic=D+E))
d=pd.DataFrame(rows).drop_duplicates("acc").reset_index(drop=True)
mis=d[d.acc=="P09440"].iloc[0]; ade=d[d.acc=="P07245"].iloc[0]
cut=(mis.ext_len+ade.ext_len)/2
d["cls"]=np.where(d.ext_len>=cut,"long","short")
L=d[d.cls=="long"]; S=d[d.cls=="short"]; short_med=int(S.ext_len.median())
ex=[]
for _,r in L.iterrows():
    seg=r.seq[:max(0,r.ext_len-short_med)]
    if len(seg)<10: continue
    R=seg.count("R");K=seg.count("K");D=seg.count("D");E=seg.count("E")
    ex.append(dict(seg_len=len(seg),net=R+K-D-E,acidic=D+E,seg=seg))
ex=pd.DataFrame(ex)
def pid(a,b):
    n=min(len(a),len(b)); return sum(1 for i in range(n) if a[i]==b[i])/n if n else 0
epairs=[pid(a,b) for a,b in itertools.islice(itertools.combinations(ex.seg.tolist(),2),400)]
cores=[r.seq[r.ext_len:r.ext_len+60] for _,r in L.iterrows()]
cpairs=[pid(a,b) for a,b in itertools.islice(itertools.combinations(cores,2),400)]

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,4.7))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(d.ext_len,bins=np.arange(0,180,5),color="#8aa1b1",edgecolor="w")
ax.axvline(ade.ext_len,color="#edae49",lw=2.5,ls="--",label=f"Ade3 ({ade.ext_len} aa)")
ax.axvline(mis.ext_len,color="#d1495b",lw=2.5,label=f"Mis1 ({mis.ext_len} aa)")
ax.set_xlabel("residues upstream of the conserved IIQVG.RPDS motif")
ax.set_ylabel("sequences")
ax.set_title("250 fungal C1-THF synthases, 188 species\nN-terminal length is bimodal")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax=axes[1]
ax.scatter(ex.seg_len,ex.net,s=30,c="#d1495b",alpha=.6,edgecolor="none")
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("length of the extra N-terminal segment (aa)")
ax.set_ylabel("net charge of that segment")
ax.set_title(f"The extra segment is basic\nmedian +{ex.net.median():.0f}, {100*(ex.net>=3).mean():.0f}% at or above +3 (n={len(ex)})")
ax=axes[2]
bins=np.linspace(0,0.9,30)
ax.hist(cpairs,bins=bins,color="#4c8dbd",alpha=.75,label=f"catalytic core, mean {100*np.mean(cpairs):.0f}%")
ax.hist(epairs,bins=bins,color="#d1495b",alpha=.7,label=f"N-terminal extension, mean {100*np.mean(epairs):.0f}%")
ax.set_xlabel("pairwise ungapped identity"); ax.set_ylabel("sequence pairs")
ax.set_title("Extensions are not conserved in sequence,\nonly in physicochemical character")
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(f"long group n={len(L)}, short group n={len(S)}; extra-segment median length {ex.seg_len.median():.0f} aa, "
      f"median net +{ex.net.median():.0f}, zero-acidic fraction {(ex.acidic==0).mean():.2f}")
print(f"extension identity {100*np.mean(epairs):.1f}% vs core identity {100*np.mean(cpairs):.1f}%")
